findings.expected_vs_actual: Expected the draft PR's pull_request run (head 58a5e55) to conclude success. Actual: run 44220403675 concluded cancelled; the job exceeded the 20-minute timeout inside 'Install Playwright system dependencies' (apt downloads from the Ubuntu mirror stalled for ~19 min) and E2E never ran. The identical step on the same commit's push run took 34 s, so this looks like a runner/mirror stall, not a workflow logic error.
findings.fix: Obtain a successful pull_request run for the PR head: re-run it (e.g. gh run rerun 44220403675 -R gregswhiteaz/texaslimittrainer) and confirm the conclusion is success. If the apt stall reproduces, make the system-dependency install resilient (e.g. a step-level timeout with retry) without weakening any check.
